fitPolicy: Speed anchor exact; alternating non-anchor speed rows fit/check. P-51 67-inHg climb fitted, 75-inHg checked; alternating Figure 5 points fit/check at source RPM. configurationPolicy: Nonnegative aggregate CD0 increment for documented open-cooling climb states only. Not isolated measured cooling drag; no aircraft-specific climb multiplier.
objective: Aircraft/group-balanced normalized squared fit residuals: speed power residual/60 hp, P51 climb/200 fpm (weight 2), other climb/250 fpm, Figure 5/60 bhp, plus weak e/config-drag regularization.
development: Initial unconstrained compression-only candidate improved climb but regressed speed. A high-J term and source-scale k=2 were evaluated; configuration drag was jointly fitted to its final listed altitude subset. Check data were seen during development/acceptance.
